messages.outbound.list.title: List outbound messages
messages.outbound.list.description: Search outbound messages with bounded offset pagination and optional filters.

messagestream.description: Filter by message stream ID. Defaults to outbound.

bounces.list.title: List bounces
bounces.list.description: List bounces with bounded offset pagination and optional filters.

type.description: Filter by bounce type, e.g. HardBounce, SoftBounce, SpamComplaint.

inactive.description: If true, return only inactive bounced recipients.

templates.list.title: List templates
templates.list.description: List templates with bounded offset pagination and optional filters.

templateActive.description: Filter by active status: true, false, or true,false.

server.get.title: Get server
server.get.description: Retrieve the current Postmark server configuration for this server token.

server.edit.title: Edit server
server.edit.description: Update settings for the current Postmark server.

Color.description: Server color on the rack screen (Purple, Blue, Turquoise, Green, Red, Yellow, Grey, Orange).

OpenHookUrl.description: URL to POST open webhook events.

BounceHookUrl.description: URL to POST bounce webhook events.

InboundHookUrl.description: URL to POST inbound email webhook events.

DeliveryHookUrl.description: URL to POST delivery webhook events.

ClickHookUrl.description: URL to POST click webhook events.

RawEmailEnabled.description: Include raw email content on inbound webhooks.

SmtpApiActivated.description: Enable SMTP API for this server.

PostFirstOpenOnly.description: Send open webhooks only on the first open.

TrackOpens.description: Enable open tracking for all mail on this server.

IncludeBounceContentInHook.description: Include bounce content in bounce webhooks.

EnableSmtpApiErrorHooks.description: Include SMTP API errors with bounce webhooks.

messages.inbound.list.title: Search inbound messages
messages.inbound.list.description: Search inbound messages with bounded offset pagination and optional filters.

count.description: Number of records to return per request. Max 500.

messages.outbound.opens.list.title: List outbound message opens
messages.outbound.opens.list.description: List open events for outbound messages with pagination and client/geo filters.

count.description: Number of records to return per request. Max 500.

recipient.description: Filter by To, Cc, or Bcc recipient.

client_company.description: Filter by client company, e.g. Microsoft, Apple, Google.

client_family.description: Filter by client family, e.g. Chrome.

os_name.description: Filter by full OS name and version.

os_family.description: Filter by OS family without version.

platform.description: Filter by platform, e.g. webmail, desktop, mobile.

messages.outbound.clicks.list.title: List outbound message clicks
messages.outbound.clicks.list.description: List click events for outbound messages with pagination and client/geo filters.

count.description: Number of records to return per request. Max 500.

recipient.description: Filter by To, Cc, or Bcc recipient.

client_name.description: Filter by client name, e.g. Outlook, Gmail.

client_company.description: Filter by client company, e.g. Microsoft, Apple, Google.

client_family.description: Filter by client family, e.g. Chrome.

os_name.description: Filter by full OS name and version.

bounces.delivery_stats.title: Get delivery stats
bounces.delivery_stats.description: Retrieve aggregated delivery statistics: inactive mails and bounce type counts.

templates.get.title: Get template
templates.get.description: Retrieve one template by numeric template ID.

templates.create.title: Create template
templates.create.description: Create a Standard or Layout email template on this server.

Subject.description: Subject content. Required for Standard templates.

HtmlBody.description: HTML body. Required unless TextBody is used for layouts.

TextBody.description: Plain-text body. Required unless HtmlBody is used for layouts.

LayoutTemplate.description: Layout template alias for Standard templates.

AssociatedServerId.description: Server ID to associate (account-level field; ignored by server-token API).

templates.edit.title: Edit template
templates.edit.description: Update an existing template by numeric ID.

Active.description: Whether the template may be used for sending.

TemplateType.description: Template type. Cannot change after creation.

LayoutTemplate.description: Layout template alias for Standard templates.

templates.delete.title: Delete template
templates.delete.description: Permanently delete a template by numeric ID or alias.

templates.validate.title: Validate template
templates.validate.description: Validate template subject/body syntax and render against sample data.

TestRenderModel.description: Mock data used to render and validate the template.

InlineCssForHtmlTestRender.description: Inline CSS when rendering HTML test output.

LayoutTemplate.description: Layout template alias used while validating a Standard template.

emails.batch_templates.send.title: Send batch templated emails
emails.batch_templates.send.description: Send up to 500 templated messages in one Postmark batch request.

Messages.description: Templated messages to send (max 500). Each item needs From, To, and TemplateId or TemplateAlias.

streams.list.title: List message streams
streams.list.description: List message streams for this server, optionally including archived streams.

streams.get.title: Get message stream
streams.get.description: Retrieve one message stream by ID.

streamID.description: Message stream ID, e.g. outbound or a custom ID.

streams.create.title: Create message stream
streams.create.description: Create a Transactional or Broadcasts message stream. Servers may have up to 10 streams.

ID.description: Stream identifier unique within the server, e.g. transactional-dev.

streams.update.title: Update message stream
streams.update.description: Update a stream's name or description. Stream type and ID cannot change after creation.

streams.archive.title: Archive message stream
streams.archive.description: Soft-delete a message stream. It is permanently purged 45 days after archiving.

streams.unarchive.title: Unarchive message stream
streams.unarchive.description: Restore a stream archived within the last 45 days.

stream_id.description: Archived message stream ID to restore.

suppressions.list.title: List suppressions
suppressions.list.description: Dump the suppression list for a message stream with optional filters.

EmailAddress.description: Filter by a specific email address.

suppressions.create.title: Create suppressions
suppressions.create.description: Add email addresses to a message stream suppression list (max 50).

Suppressions.description: Email addresses as {EmailAddress} objects. Max 50 per request.

suppressions.delete.title: Delete suppressions
suppressions.delete.description: Remove HardBounce or ManualSuppression entries. SpamComplaint suppressions cannot be deleted.

Suppressions.description: Email addresses as {EmailAddress} objects. Max 50 per request.

webhooks.list.title: List webhooks
webhooks.list.description: List webhook configurations for this server, optionally filtered by message stream.

webhooks.get.title: Get webhook
webhooks.get.description: Retrieve one webhook by ID, including URL, triggers, and stream.

webhooks.create.title: Create webhook
webhooks.create.description: Create a webhook for outbound tracking events on a message stream.

Url.description: HTTPS URL that receives webhook POSTs.

MessageStream.description: Message stream for this webhook. Defaults to outbound.

Triggers.description: Event triggers (Open, Click, Delivery, Bounce, SpamComplaint, SubscriptionChange).

Verify.description: Test the endpoint against each enabled event before saving. Defaults to true.

webhooks.edit.title: Edit webhook
webhooks.edit.description: Update a webhook URL or triggers. Postmark re-verifies enabled events unless Verify is false.

Url.description: HTTPS URL that receives webhook POSTs.

Triggers.description: Event triggers to enable or disable.

AuthToken.description: Optional secret. Prefer HttpAuth {Username, Password} which the API accepts.

Verify.description: Re-test the endpoint before saving. Defaults to true.

inbound_rules.list.title: List inbound rules
inbound_rules.list.description: List inbound blocking rules (email or domain) with required count/offset pagination.

count.description: Number of records to return per request. Max 500.

inbound_rules.create.title: Create inbound rule
inbound_rules.create.description: Block inbound mail from an email address or domain.

Rule.description: Email address or domain to block, e.g. spam@example.com or baddomain.com.

inbound_rules.delete.title: Delete inbound rule
inbound_rules.delete.description: Delete an inbound blocking rule by trigger ID.

stats.outbound.overview.description: Retrieve aggregated outbound statistics for this server.

messagestream.description: Filter by message stream ID. Omit for all streams.

stats.outbound.clicks.browsers.description: Retrieve click statistics grouped by browser family. Composio FromDate/ToDate map to official fromdate/todate. ServerID is accepted but not sent; the server token already scopes the server.

stats.outbound.clicks.browser_families.title: Get clicks by browser family

stats.outbound.clicks.location.description: Retrieve an overview of whether tracked links were clicked from HTML or Text bodies.

email.description: Full raw email source, including headers.

options.description: Report detail: short, long, or summary. Official API documents short and long.
